title: Production Support Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**About the Role**

Citi's Securities Services division is seeking a Senior Production Support Analyst to join the Data & Client Platforms (DCP) Production Support team — a globally distributed, 24×6 function supporting business-critical and client-facing data and reporting platforms across Investor & Issuer Services.

This is a senior operational role that sits at the intersection of data platform operations, client service delivery, and technology transformation. The DCP PS team supports an expanding portfolio of platforms serving some of the world's largest institutional investors, across multiple geographies and business lines within Investor & Issuer Services.

The team is actively investing in engineering capability, automation, and AI-assisted operations — making this an opportunity for candidates who want to grow beyond traditional incident management into a forward-looking, engineering-oriented production support function.

**What You Will Be Working On**

The DCP platform underpins Citi's data distribution, client reporting, and operational data services across Securities Services. You will be supporting a portfolio of proprietary and industry-standard platforms spanning:

* **Client data and reporting platforms** — real-time and end-of-day data delivery, client reporting, and operational oversight tools
* **Data lake and cloud-native platforms** — next-generation cloud data infrastructure built on modern technologies including Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Couchbase, Amazon S3, and DataBricks
* **Client-facing digital experience** — platforms delivering data, reporting, and instructions to institutional clients via Citi's digital channels
* **Entitlements and data access management** — infrastructure governing client and user access to data services

The platform is undergoing significant transformation — including migration of applications to modernised digital platforms, consolidation of data services across business lines, and adoption of cloud-native data lake architectures. You will be directly involved in supporting this evolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Operations**

* Provide L2 production support across the DCP application portfolio — incident triage, investigation, escalation, and resolution — operating within a global follow-the-sun support model
* Perform start-of-day checks, continuous platform monitoring, and structured regional handovers to ensure seamless 24×6 coverage
* Manage and resolve user and client-reported incidents via ServiceNow, maintaining SLA adherence and clear communication throughout the incident lifecycle

**Client Service & Communication**

* Act as the internal operational point of contact for client-impacting incidents — providing timely, accurate, and professional communication to client-facing teams including Client Services, Technology Relationship Managers, and Operations
* Proactively identify and escalate data quality and service availability issues — contributing to a detect-first operating model that reduces client-reported incidents
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of a centralised service level inventory — ensuring Citi's commitments to institutional clients are tracked, governed, and met

**Platform Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and drive resolution of recurring incident patterns through structured problem management — reducing manual toil and preventing reoccurrence
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, support documentation, and operational procedures across the platform portfolio
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives — using tools including Grafana, ITRS, and GCO — to reduce manual effort and improve platform monitoring coverage
* Participate in change management activities including release preparation, deployment support, post-implementation review, and production risk assessments

**Engineering & AI Enablement**

* Actively engage with and adopt AI-assisted tooling for incident troubleshooting, automated investigation, and resiliency gap detection — aligned to Citi's firm-wide AI-driven production management strategy
* Contribute to operational readiness for new platform migrations and onboarding — ensuring production support capability keeps pace with technology evolution
* Partner with development and platform engineering teams to influence upstream design decisions that improve production operability and resilience

**Transformation & Programme Delivery**

* Participate in continuous improvement workstream items spanning automation efficiency, monitoring uplift, resiliency, and application onboarding
* Support DCP's expansion as the central data services hub across Investor & Issuer Services
* Contribute to business continuity planning, contingency testing, and resiliency exercises across the platform portfolio

**Team & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for one or more platforms — owning operational knowledge and serving as escalation point for junior team members
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with Development, Platform Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Audit, Infrastructure, and Vendor/Partner teams
* Contributing to the team's reputation as a value-adding, engineering-oriented function

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 4 to 8 years in an application support, production management, or platform operations role — preferably within financial services or data-intensive environments
* Hands-on experience supporting data pipelines, reporting platforms, or client-facing financial applications
* Experience working within a global, follow-the-sun support model across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and data querying — ability to investigate data quality issues across relational and cloud databases
* Experience with Snowflake, Couchbase, Amazon S3, or DataBricks is advantageous
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling such as Grafana or ITRS or GCO
* Experience with automation scripting (Python, Shell, or equivalent) — ability and willingness to build and maintain operational automation
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms for incident and problem management
* Understanding of cloud-native data architectures — data lakes, streaming pipelines, and event-driven architecture — is advantageous
* Interest in and exposure to AI-assisted operations tooling — agentic triage, automated incident investigation, or intelligent monitoring

**Behavioural & Professional**

* Strong analytical and investigative mindset — able to work through complex, ambiguous production issues methodically and under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders including client-facing teams and senior management
* Client-first orientation — understands the impact of production issues on institutional clients and takes ownership of communication and resolution
* Proactive and improvement-oriented — actively looks for ways to reduce toil, improve processes, and uplift team capability
* Collaborative — operates effectively in a geographically distributed team with shared accountability for platform health
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change — the DCP platform is in active transformation and the role requires adaptability as scope, technology, and operating model evolve

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline — or equivalent professional experience

**Why Join DCP Production Support at Citi**

* **Strategic importance** — DCP PS supports Citi's Securities Services data and client experience infrastructure, serving some of the world's largest institutional investors across a platform undergoing major transformation
* **Engineering growth** — the team is actively investing in automation, AI-assisted operations, and engineering capability — this is a role for candidates who want to grow beyond incident management into a technically sophisticated, forward-looking function
* **Global reach** — work within a globally distributed follow-the-sun team across EMEA, NAM, and Asia Pacific with genuine cross-regional collaboration and career mobility
* **Transformation exposure** — direct involvement in major platform programmes including cloud data lake modernisation, client platform migration, and multi-business-line data services consolidation
* **AI-forward environment** — early involvement in AI-assisted production management tooling aligned to Citi's firm-wide intelligent operations strategy

description:
We are looking for a dedicated **HR Recruiter** to manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for our manufacturing facility and corporate operations. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and hiring a diverse workforce—ranging from skilled machine operators and technicians to production supervisors and engineering staff. The ideal candidate understands the fast-paced nature of plant environments, local labor regulations, and blue-collar/white-collar staffing dynamics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Recruitment:** Partner with plant heads, production managers, and department leads to forecast staffing needs and fill open shop-floor and technical roles promptly.
* **Blue-Collar & Technical Sourcing:** Source candidates for roles such as CNC operators, quality inspectors, electricians, safety officers, line supervisors, and maintenance technicians using local networks, walk-in drives, job portals (Naukri, Indeed), and local employment exchanges.
* **Screening & Interviews:** Review applications, conduct telephonic/video/in-person screenings, and evaluate candidates for core technical competence, shift flexibility, safety awareness, and cultural fit.
* **Compliance & Background Verification:** Ensure all hires meet statutory labor laws, age compliance, safety protocols, background checks, and pre-employment medical fitness tests.
* **Onboarding & Induction:** Coordinate joining formalities, safety orientation, plant tours, ID card issuance, and handover to the plant HR team for seamless integration.
* **Data & Metrics Reporting:** Maintain accurate applicant tracking systems (ATS) or HRIS databases and track key recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and attrition rates during probation.
* **Vendor & Agency Management:** Coordinate with third-party manpower contractors, staffing agencies, and technical training institutes (ITI/polytechnics) for bulk or contract hiring.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**Company Description**

**About MSX****Driving the Future of Mobility**  
  
At MSX, we partner with the world’s leading automotive and mobility brands to reimagine their operations. We make businesses smarter, more sustainable, and future-ready by combining global talent with cutting-edge technology and AI-powered innovation.  
  
**Our Purpose & Vision**  
Our reason for being is to **empower Movers and Makers to thrive in an ever-changing world**. We strive to be our clients' first choice, recognized for operational excellence and a relentless commitment to driving change across the mobility industry.  
  
**What We Do & How We Do It**  
We harness our expertise in mobility and the creativity of our global teams to craft tailored solutions. We help brands:  
  
Earn lasting customer loyalty and reinvent the retail experience. Optimize sales performance, parts management, and repair compliance. Transform data into meaningful insights and streamlined field operations. Leverage advanced technology platforms and immersive learning to unlock human potential.  
  
**MSX by the Numbers**  
  
5,000+ Team Members worldwide.30 Global Locations with **5** International Hubs.25+ Years of automotive industry leadership.

 **Job Description**

At MSX we exist to empower movers and makers to thrive in an ever-changing world, by harnessing our expertise and creativity to deliver an exceptional service powered by technology and innovative solutions.

The Senior Recruiter contributes to the MSX Vision, Mission and Purpose by actively partnering with stakeholders and supporting the end-to-end Talent Attraction Process. As first point of contact for hiring managers, the role defines recruitment needs, sourcing and screening approaches, working with Business owners and Market specialists through to the recruitment phase. The role plays a key part in improving selection effectiveness and providing a great candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Run end-to-end recruitment for diversified positions across the business
* Engage hiring managers and business owners on recruitment needs and pipelines
* Source candidates via active and passive channels (LinkedIn, networks, referrals)
* Screen CVs and conduct competency-based interviews
* Create targeted job advertisements and employer branding content
* Manage candidate data in ATS and HRIS systems
* Coordinate interview loops, assessments and offer management
* Track and report on recruitment KPIs and SLAs
* Support onboarding and integration of new employees
* Liaise with senior recruiters and recruitment team leaders on complex roles
* Build candidate experience through proactive communication
* Identify and propose selection process improvements

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Psychology, Business or related field preferred
* Equivalent significant practical experience in recruitment may be considered
* HR Qualification / Degree (desirable)
* Training in interview techniques, ATS or competency-based selection an advantage

**Experience:**

* Previous success within a Recruitment role / environment
* Demonstrable experience in achieving KPIs
* Experience of managing diversified positions / stakeholders
* Experience with ATS, HRIS and sourcing platforms preferred

**Knowledge:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of sourcing, recruitment and interviewing methods and techniques
* Awareness of HR practices, employment law and candidate experience principles

**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters) and HRIS systems
* Advanced sourcing (LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, talent intelligence)
* Competency-based interview frameworks and assessment platforms
* Job advert creation and employer branding tools

**Core Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail in candidate data and recruitment KPIs
* Ability to multitask across diversified vacancies and stakeholders
* Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and hiring managers
* Customer-focused candidate experience across the funnel
* Reliable follow-through on candidate and stakeholder commitments

**Core Competencies:**

* Customer Focus — actively seeks and acts on customer feedback.
* Drive for Results — consistently delivers on commitments and KPIs.
* Collaboration & Influence — partners effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Coaching & Developing Others — supports the development of less experienced colleagues.
* Process Improvement — identifies and implements improvements to ways of working.

 **Additional Information**

**At MSX we Value:**

* Getting it done
* Proving our words with our actions
* Creating a better tomorrow for our clients, every single day
* Fearlessly exploring new roads
* Delivering on our commitments
* Being exceptional teammates

**We expect everyone at MSX to:**

* Be decisive, solution oriented and results focused
* Hold themselves and others accountable to commitments
* Focus on delivering great outcomes for their internal or external customers, and respectfully and constructively challenge key stakeholders to consider better solutions
* Overcome challenges with positivity and creativity
* Be adaptable and open to change, and motivated to explore new and improved ways of working
* Support teammates to succeed by sharing experience and knowledge, and by giving and receiving honest feedback

**In addition, we expect the Senior Recruiter to be:**

* Candidate-focused and service-oriented
* Detail-oriented in candidate data and recruitment KPIs
* Reliable and consistent in applying recruitment procedures
* Calm and professional with candidates and hiring managers
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous improvement
* Adaptable across diversified roles, markets and stakeholders
* A positive representative of MSX with candidates and the talent market
* Quality- and confidentiality-driven across all recruitment activities

MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Hiring for FP&A Analyst
description:
**Job description**

Boson Motors seeks an **FP\&A Analyst** to provide financial analysis, planning, and reporting to support executive decision\-making. Report to CFO and partner with operations, manufacturing, and sales teams to build financial models, track performance, and deliver actionable insights driving strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop financial models for revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasting; build quarterly/annual budgets
* Conduct variance analysis and scenario planning (base/best/worst case) for executive decision\-support
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports; create KPI dashboards and executive presentations
* Analyze unit economics, gross margin, and cost optimization opportunities
* Support investor relations, capital planning, and ad\-hoc strategic financial analysis
* Improve forecasting processes and automate reporting workflows

Required Qualifications

* **Education:** Bachelor's in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field
* **Experience:** 2\-4 years in FP\&A, corporate finance, or financial analysis; startup/growth\-stage environment preferred
* **Technical:** Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data consolidation); experience with financial planning software ; data visualization tools
* **Skills:** Strong quantitative analysis, financial statement understanding, unit economics, scenario modeling; excellent communication and presentation abilities
* **Mindset:** Detail\-oriented, adaptable, collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity in fast\-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

* EV, automotive, or renewable energy sector experience(preferrable)
* Manufacturing/supply chain financial analysis(Preferrable)
* Any other sectors

Key Deliverables

* Monthly management reporting packs (P\&L, variance analysis, KPI dashboards)
* Quarterly forecast updates and variance commentaries
* Annual budget and long\-range financial plan (3\-5 years)
* Executive presentations and board\-ready materials
* Ad\-hoc analyses supporting strategic decisions (2\-4 per quarter)

title: Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Talent Acquisition / Recruitment professional with hands\-on experience in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment. The candidate will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment, building talent pipelines, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring timely closure of positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage end\-to\-end recruitment from manpower requirement to candidate joining.

· Handle IT, Non\-IT, Volume/Bulk, Managerial and Niche hiring across various functions.

· Understand hiring requirements and prepare/finalize Job Descriptions (JDs) with stakeholders.

· Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, databases, consultants and direct sourcing.

· Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/video interviews to assess technical/functional skills, experience, communication, notice period, compensation and role fit.

· Coordinate technical, functional, managerial and HR interview rounds and ensure timely feedback.

· Build and maintain talent pipelines and candidate databases for current and future requirements.

· Manage salary discussions, offer approvals, offer rollout and pre\-joining follow\-up to improve offer\-to\-join conversion.

· Ensure positions are closed within defined recruitment TAT/SLA while maintaining candidate quality.

· Prepare recruitment MIS and dashboards covering vacancies, pipeline, interviews, selections, offers, joining, TAT and source effectiveness.

· Track and control recruitment costs related to portals, consultants, advertisements and other hiring activities.

· Support recruitment drives, employee referrals, campus hiring and other talent acquisition initiatives.

· Stay updated on market trends, talent availability, salary trends, emerging skills and recruitment best practices.

· Leverage ATS, recruitment technology and AI\-based sourcing/screening tools to improve recruitment efficiency.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

· 2–5 years of hands\-on recruitment / talent acquisition experience.

· Proven experience in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment.

· Experience in volume hiring and managerial/niche recruitment will be an advantage.

· Strong sourcing and headhunting skills with hands\-on experience in Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.

· Good understanding of technical and functional candidate screening.

· Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management and follow\-up skills.

· Experience with ATS / recruitment databases.

· Strong working knowledge of Advanced MS Excel and recruitment MIS/analytics.

· Familiarity with AI\-enabled recruitment tools is preferred.

· Target\-oriented, proactive, analytical and capable of independently managing multiple requirements.
